player_prompt.intro: Waxaad ku ciyaareysaa Tower of Hanoi oo leh {num_disks} disks. Waa inaad disks ka guurto tower A ilaa tower C. Si aad u guurto disk, qor tower source iyo tower target (tusaale, '[A C]). Ogsoonow inaad kaliya dhaqaajin karto diskka sare ee munaarad, iyo in disk ka weyn aan lagu dhigi karin disk yar. Wareeg kasta, u gudbi hal dhaqaaq.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ma aadan jawaabin '[source] [target]' oo sax ah.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: Waxaad sheegtay isha aan sax ahayn ama munaarad aan sax ahayn.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Waxaad isku dayday inaad ka guurto qalab disk ah oo ku jira munaarad madhan.
invalid_move.same_tower: Waxaad isku dayday in aad u guurto disk ah in ay Tower la mid ah.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Waxaad isku dayday in aad ku ridid disk weyn disk yar.

outcome.win: Hambalyo! Waxaad xalisay halxiraalaha Tower of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Xadka wareega ayaa la gaadhay. Waxaad si sax ah u dhigtay {pct}% oo ah diskiyada ku yaal Tower C.
